subject: Acme prepay: 2yr vs 3yr term — discount request, ramp & approval
messages:
From: Evan Sweeney <evan.sweeney@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Prepay options for multi-year deal — Acme RFP attached

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Acme is evaluating Redwood for our inference layer and procurement asked me to share preferred commercial structures before we engage procurement formally. Attached is a short RFP with our target capacity and a sample ramp. Two questions for you:

1) Can you provide a priced option for a 2-year prepay and a 3-year prepay (we would pay upfront). Please include the discount from list and any assumptions on token usage and burst capacity.
2) Are you able to provide a steeper discount for a committed ramp (we expect to hit ~30% of committed Q1, 60% by Q4 of year one)?

We are targeting an internal commercial review by Nov 10, so would appreciate a quick note by then.

Attachment: Acme_RFP_preferred_terms.pdf

Best,
Evan
Head of Cloud Platform
Acme Corporation

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Sweeney <evan.sweeney@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prepay options for multi-year deal — Acme RFP attached

Evan — thanks for the clear brief and the RFP. I pulled together two commercial options and assumptions below; attaching a short draft proposal for your internal review.

Quick summary (high level):
- Option A — 2-year prepaid (100% upfront): 35% discount off list; committed tokens 12M/year; ramp schedule as you described.
- Option B — 3-year prepaid (100% upfront): 42% discount off list; committed tokens 10M/yr year1 rising to 14M/yr by year3; requires 60% of year1 committed to be available as prepaid credit at signing.

Assumptions: list pricing = standard hosted API rates; discounts apply to generation calls only; embeddings priced separately (we can include in final SOW). We included a recommended SLA add-on for enterprise customers.

If you'd like, I can pull finance to confirm the incremental discount band for multiyear. Draft attached (rwinf-proposal-draft.pdf).

Next steps: let me know which option you want me to firm up and I'll route for internal approvals.

Attachment: rwinf-proposal-draft.pdf

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Prepay options for multi-year deal — Acme RFP attached (approval request)

Folks — forwarding Acme's ask and the two options I proposed. High level financials below — want to confirm delegation before I commit to the 42% figure for a 3-year prepay.

Customer: Acme Corporation (strategic — platform-wide opportunity)
ARR impact (first 12 months): $1.2M recognized; prepay cash up front $2.4M if they do 2yr, $3.1M for 3yr.
Estimated gross margin impact at 42% discount: ~22% (includes infra cost + support uplift).

Options proposed to customer:
- 2yr / 35% discount — within AE delegated discount band.
- 3yr / 42% discount — above AE band; requires finance/OPS sign-off.

Request: Marcus/Tessa — confirm if finance can approve 42% for strategic motion or do we need VP sign-off. Also confirm whether the conditional prepay threshold (60% prepay required for 3yr) is acceptable from a revenue recognition perspective.

I put the draft pricing workbook in attachments when I ran the model.

Thanks,
Laura

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Prepay options for multi-year deal — Acme (finance view)

Laura/Tessa — reviewed the numbers. A few notes:
- 42% on the 3yr is outside AE delegated authority and is a material concession given estimated unit economics.
- Finance can stretch to 40% with our standard enterprise clauses and minimum prepaid threshold (60% year1) but anything >40% requires VP approval (Vivek).
- Revenue recognition: 100% prepay will be treated as deferred revenue; no blockers for that but make sure procurement agrees to the invoice schedule.

I attached the model I used (pricing-model.xlsx) with sensitivity to utilization. If they plan multi-region expansion (APAC), that changes margin a bit.

If you want to request 42% from Vivek, call it out as strategic / expansion motion.

-Marcus

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-05T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme prepay options — approval for conditional 3yr at 42%

Thanks for the context. I approve moving forward with Option B (3-year, 42% discount) on the following conditions:
1) Customer provides >= 60% of year1 commitment as prepaid at signing.
2) Contract must include audit rights (SOC2 evidence already requested) and a termination-for-convenience clause with a 90-day notice and pro-rated refund for unused prepaid credits beyond 12 months (legal to finalize).
3) We require an executive intro and kickoff within 30 days to ensure they realize the platform value (we're protecting expansion).

Finance note: we accept the deferred revenue hit given strategic value and ACME's enterprise profile. Marcus/Tessa — please shepherd legal/rev-rec. Laura — you can share final commercial and request signature.

-Vivek
Head of Sales Ops

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Sweeney <evan.sweeney@acme.com>
Cc: Diane Holden <diane.holden@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-06T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Final commercial for 3yr prepaid — DocuSign link included

Evan — great to align. Per our conversation, we've finalized the 3-year prepay offer at 42% discount with the conditions Vivek outlined. Key points in the attached commercial sheet:
- Term: 36 months, 100% prepaid at signing (we will accept 60% prepaid + payment schedule for remaining 40% if needed — see payment schedule options).
- Discount: 42% off list for generation calls (embeddings quoted separately).
- Ramp: 30% of committed by end of Q1, 60% by end of Q4 year1, target steady-state by month 18.
- Audit & termination clauses included; legal will send finalized SOW.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/links/rwinf/acme/prepay-20251106
Attachment: rwinf-final-commercial-sheet.pdf

Please review and let me know if you want to adjust the payment schedule; we can provide a 60/40 or a 100% up-front option. Looking for signature by Nov 14 to meet your procurement timeline.

Cheers,
Laura

From: Diane Holden <diane.holden@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Evan Sweeney <evan.sweeney@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-10T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final commercial for 3yr prepaid — DocuSign link included

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the commercial and asked for a small change to the ramp/payment schedule: they prefer a 50/50 payment split at signing and 6 months later (instead of 60/40). They also requested the option to withhold up to 10% of the prepaid as an escrow to be released after the first enterprise onboarding milestone to mitigate early adoption risk.

Can Redwood accommodate that without changing the discount? If so, please send an updated DocuSign. We still aim to sign before Nov 14.

Best,
Diane
Director, Strategic Procurement
Acme Corporation

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diane Holden <diane.holden@acme.com>, Evan Sweeney <evan.sweeney@acme.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-11T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final commercial for 3yr prepaid — DocuSign link included (updated)

Diane/Evan — appreciate the procurement feedback. We can accept the 50/50 payment split and the 10% onboarding escrow without adjusting the 42% discount, subject to legal-approved escrow language in the SOW. Marcus/Vivek — legal please confirm standard escrow clause and sign-off on refund timing.

I've updated the commercial sheet and regenerated the DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/links/rwinf/acme/prepay-20251111
Attachment: rwinf-final-commercial-sheet.pdf (v2 - payment schedule updated)

Evan — if that looks good, please sign the DocuSign by Nov 14 and we'll escalate kickoff to PM and CS for onboarding. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
